meta.siteTitle: Love Pratap — Security Analyst & Penetration Tester
meta.description: Portfolio of Love Pratap, a Security Analyst specializing in manual web application, network, API and mobile penetration testing.

hero.name: Love Pratap
hero.description: I break web applications, networks and APIs to find the flaws automated scanners miss — business logic bypasses, authentication bypasses, IDOR, SSRF and chained attack paths. Then I help teams fix them.

about.lead: I'm a hands-on Application Security Consultant with around three years of experience in manual web application penetration testing, network VAPT and mobile security assessments.
paragraphs: My work focuses on identifying complex business logic flaws, authentication bypasses, IDOR, SSRF and chained vulnerabilities that automated scanners typically miss. I'm proficient with Burp Suite, Kali Linux, Nmap and Python for custom PoCs and testing automation.

I work closely with development and infrastructure teams to translate technical findings into clear impact, reproducible proof-of-concepts and pragmatic remediation roadmaps — because finding the bug is only half the job.

experience.title: Security Analyst
bullets: Lead manual and deep-dive Web Application Penetration Testing across critical national infrastructure and government portals, discovering high-severity OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, privilege escalations and complex business logic flaws.
Perform Network VAPT and API penetration testing across supporting perimeter infrastructure, developing custom Python scripts to validate chained exploit vectors.
Conduct targeted security assessments for auxiliary Android mobile client applications, analyzing insecure data storage and transit vulnerabilities.
Collaborate directly with cross-functional development teams and system administrators to explain vulnerability impact and guide effective remediation strategies.
Deliver comprehensive penetration testing reports featuring step-by-step reproducible PoCs and pragmatic risk ratings.

experience.title: Security Engineer
bullets: Executed comprehensive network infrastructure vulnerability assessments and perimeter security testing, identifying exposure vectors, outdated services and misconfigurations.
Engineered and audited enterprise email authentication frameworks (DMARC, SPF, DKIM), eliminating domain spoofing and phishing attack vectors.
Automated vulnerability tracking and compliance auditing across 90+ enterprise endpoints, streamlining baseline hardening and patch management.
Interfaced with engineering teams to validate security fixes and confirm resolution of identified infrastructure vulnerabilities.

experience.title: Cyber Security Analyst
bullets: Spearheaded manual Web Application VAPT for proprietary portals, identifying zero-state logic flaws, SQL injection, stored XSS and broken access controls.
Conducted internal network penetration tests and host discovery scans to evaluate the resilience of perimeter defenses and segmentation controls.
Developed lightweight Python utilities and custom Burp Suite payload generation scripts to automate repetitive parameter inspection and fuzzing tasks.
Maintained structured technical vulnerability documentation, assisting developer and QA teams in implementing robust defensive controls.

projects.title: Custom Security Tooling & PoC Automation

projects.label: Open Source · Browser Extension
projects.title: VAPT Lens
projects.description: A guided, read-only security-testing assistant for Chrome and Firefox. It maps a page's attack surface — parameters, headers, technologies and site map — then serves step-by-step "what to test and how" cards powered by offensive-security skills and optional Burp traffic import. Never sends payloads, submits forms or logs in.
